test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends are sitting in a bench facing east. Falak is third to the right of Charu. There are only two people sitting between Sargun and Karan. Charu is at the North end of the bench. Arav is sitting to the immediate left of Falak. Vaibhav and Karan are sitting immediately next to each other. Who is sitting second from the south end?
solution:
**Given: **

Six Friends: Falak, Charu, Sargun, Karan, Arav and Vaibhav

1.Falak is third to the right of Charu.

2. Charu is at the North end of the bench.

3.Arav is sitting to the immediate left of Falak.

**Case 1:**

**Case 2:**

 4.Vaibhav and Karan are sitting immediately next to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/18eb2ae149dac2fe570ba0ccf823646396767320dd2fc417f8889a6516729656.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e1ce76334cfdf2a154ffa95a6b7fb34fd13505c3793b65f292dfc83e7ae61d7.png]

 5.There are only two people sitting between Sargun and Karan.

**so case 1.1, 2.1 and 2.2 gets cancelled.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddcce4caa7e0ddf3ac79d01f39d29601d170315cf49f989e8b4d59a20bac5b3c.png] 

Hence__**. Karan**__ is the correct answer.
